Rafael Nadal vs Dominic Thiem - Final Highlights I Roland-Garros 2018. Watch the highlights of the great final between Rafael Nadal and Dominic Thiem. The Spanish won in straight sets 6/4 6/3 6/2 and claims his 11th Roland Garros.
This is the official YouTube Channel of Roland Garros, home of the French Open. The tournament 2018 will run from 21 May - 10 June.
